youtube_description:
Invite the bot (when it releases): https://gdcolon.com/zoo/

Zoo is a free Discord minigame that I started two years ago for my old Discord Bot, RoboTop. Over that time, it kept growing bigger and bigger until I decided that it's finally time to make it something independent. After six painstaking months of rewriting everything from the ground up (as well as adding TONS of new content), it's finally ready to see the light of day!

trade me all of your foxes btw
